evidence.reason: `schema_problem` promises to return the first schema violation rather than raise, but `_SCHEMA_TYPES` has no `number` entry. A receipt rule with `type: "number"` therefore makes the lookup `_SCHEMA_TYPES[t]` raise `KeyError`, aborting the local-review verdict and tick result instead of reporting an unsupported/type-mismatch diagnostic. The fix is to detect unsupported type names before indexing and return a diagnostic.
